design.same_turn_enqueue: The pass checks admitted(); runFlagEffect calls the body inline; run records the decision; host.perform captures its inputs and calls the nonisolated(nonsending) PlatformWork.run, which enqueues on the host's serial queue. All of this happens before the first suspension, so the order on the FIFO is the order of the decisions.
design.quiescence: Stop's tearDown awaits quiesceEffects() before it reads the baseline or queues any clear. The flag effect's handle ends only after the host's settlement and the reconciler's adopt have run.
design.landed_facts: A completion records only its own group, at the value its pass carried. It promotes no whole or stale baseline and never writes requested*. Once the admission lapses, no group that no action named is recorded. Parent and reviewer both confirmed this is correct under existing policy; no owner decision is needed.
design.results_preserved: clears land when nothing throws and the journal shows no managed state; a partial environment apply lands and reports its shortfall; system DNS lands when saved && applied; failures go to ConfigReapplyRetry with the token of the run they were decided under
design.timer_guard_removed: The token guard is gone. Every operation that supersedes the DNS lane runs tearDown, which quiesces and then calls stopDNSHealthTimer(), so the guard could not be observed and would have masked a broken quiesce ordering. The DNS witness pins that ordering.

list_rewrite_semantics.same_order: The list order is the chain order, left to right. lazy.compactMap(...).first returns the first non-nil pinnedHost in that order and stops there, as '??' did.
list_rewrite_semantics.nothing_runs_early: All ten values are Shutdown values computed before this else-branch, and the expression reads only their pinnedHost properties. Building the list copies those finished values; it invokes no exercise, cleanup, flush or release. The '??' short-circuit only skipped further pure property reads.
list_rewrite_semantics.gating_unchanged: Each exercise still runs only when every earlier one quiesced. An exercise that did not run keeps its pinnedHost: nil placeholder.
list_rewrite_semantics.release_unchanged: Root release still requires all ten quiesced. Otherwise the else-branch pins the chosen host, keeps the root and scratch directory, and fails 'the shutdown is confirmed'. The per-exercise stop, settle and flush are untouched.
list_rewrite_semantics.first_failure_choice: Because of the gating, at most one exercise can be unconfirmed and pinned: the first one that failed to quiesce, after which none runs. The list and the chain pick that same host.
